title: Analysis: China’s quarterly CO2 falls 3% in largest drop since Covid
zh_title: 分析：中国季度二氧化碳排放量下降 3%，创新冠疫情以来最大降幅
summary: 由于霍尔木兹危机继续打击石油需求，煤炭使用量也下降，2026年第三季度中国二氧化碳（CO2）排放量下降了3.1%。这篇客座文章作者：Lauri Myllyvirta，能源与清洁空气研究中心首席分析师 这是自 2022 年新冠疫情封锁以来最大的季度减排量，意味着中国的二氧化碳排放量今年迄今已估计下降了 0.5%。 Carbon Brief 根据官方数据和商业数据进行的新分析显示，2026 年第三季度煤炭使用量同比下降 3%，而石油使用量则同比下降 3%。
content:
由于霍尔木兹危机继续打击石油需求，煤炭使用量也下降，2026年第三季度中国二氧化碳（CO2）排放量下降了3.1%。这篇客座文章作者：Lauri Myllyvirta，能源与清洁空气研究中心首席分析师 这是自 2022 年新冠疫情封锁以来最大的季度减排量，意味着中国的二氧化碳排放量今年迄今已估计下降了 0.5%。 Carbon Brief基于官方数据和商业数据的新分析显示，2026年第三季度煤炭使用量同比下降3%，而石油使用量下降4%。主要驱动因素是电力行业煤炭消费下降、交通运输油消费持续大幅下降以及煤化工增速放缓。中国二氧化碳排放量的大幅下降延续了自2024年3月开始至今已持续两年多的“持平或下降”趋势，如下图所示。本分析的先前迭代中列出的数据源。中国二氧化碳排放的前景取决于不断增长的能源需求、清洁能源增长和政府对GDP放缓的反应之间的平衡。下降驱动因素 2026 年第三季度二氧化碳排放量下降的主要驱动因素包括煤炭发电量下降 3.3%，原因是需求增长放缓以及“浪费”的风能和太阳能发电量下降。
太阳能、风能和核能发电量同比增长110太瓦时（TWh），是总电力需求增长量的两倍多。这相当于德国同期总发电量。尽管中国继续以接近创纪录的速度建设新的煤电产能，但煤电产量和二氧化碳排放量仍出现下降。这意味着燃煤电厂的平均运行时间下降速度甚至超过总发电量下降速度，从而侵蚀了它们的利润。与此同时，运输石油消耗继续大幅下降，2026年第三季度同比下降9%。电动汽车(EV)继续扩大市场份额，9月份创下了乘用车销量的67%和重型卡车销量的50%的纪录。电动汽车的用电量增长了 53%，远远快于道路上电动汽车的数量，这表明现有车队的使用量比燃油汽车的使用量有所增加。其他方面，煤化工行业增长在2026年第三季度继续放缓。该行业一直是排放增长的主要来源，但煤炭价格高企削弱了盈利能力，而较高的产出价格损害了下游需求。最后，随着建筑量收缩加速，水泥和钢铁生产的二氧化碳排放量在第三季度继续下降。
排放展望新冠疫情期间经历了一段时期的异常高增长后，能源消费增长一直在下降，而清洁能源增长强劲。这使得今年清洁发电的增长可能超过能源需求总量的增长，从而维持化石燃料使用的结构性下降。展望未来，这种平衡还依赖于消除新太阳能和风能并网障碍的进展，这会导致一些清洁电力被“浪费”。最近能源需求增长放缓的部分原因（但并非全部原因）是第三季度异常温和的天气。另一个关键因素是GDP增长疲软。然而，由于报告的GDP增长仍在目标范围内

【原文 English Original】
China’s carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions fell by 3.1% in the third quarter of 2026, as the Hormuz crisis continued to hit oil demand and coal use also dropped. This guest post is by: Lauri Myllyvirta, lead analyst at the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air This was the largest quarterly reduction since the 2022 Covid lockdowns and means that China’s CO2 emissions have now fallen by an estimated 0.5% in the year to date. The new analysis for Carbon Brief, based on official figures and commercial data, shows that coal use fell by 3% year-on-year in the third quarter of 2026, while oil was down 4%. The main drivers were a fall in power-sector coal consumption, a continued sharp reduction in transport oil consumption and slowing growth in the coal-to-chemical industry. The sharp decline in China’s CO2 emissions extends a “ flat or falling ” trend that began in March 2024 and has now lasted more than two years, as shown in the figure below. Data sources as listed in previous iterations of this analysis. The outlook for China’s CO2 emissions depends on the balance between rising energy demand, clean-energy growth and the government response to a GDP slowdown . Decline drivers Key drivers of the fall in CO2 in the third quarter of 2026 included a 3.3% drop in coal-power generation, after demand growth slowed and the amount of “ wasted ” wind and solar fell. Power generation from solar, wind and nuclear increased by 110 terawatt hours (TWh) year-on-year, more than twice as much as the growth in total electricity demand. This added clean-power generation equal to Germany’s total power output in the same time period. The fall in coal-power output and CO2 emissions came despite the fact that China continues to build new coal-power capacity at near-record rates . This means that average running hours for coal plants are falling even faster than total generation, eroding their profits. Meanwhile, transport oil consumption continued to fall sharply, down 9% year-on-year in the third quarter of 2026. Electric vehicles (EVs) continued to gain market share, hitting a record 67% of passenger car sales and 50% of heavy trucks in September. The amount of electricity used by EVs grew by 53%, much faster than the number of EVs on the road, showing increased usage of the existing fleet in preference to fuelled vehicles. Elsewhere, growth in the coal-to-chemical industry continued to slow down in the third quarter of 2026. The sector has been a key source of emissions growth, but high coal prices have weakened profitability and higher output prices hurt downstream demand . Finally, CO2 emissions from cement and steel production continued to fall in the third quarter, as the contraction in construction volumes accelerated . Outlook for emissions Energy consumption growth has been falling after a period of exceptionally high growth during Covid, while clean-power growth has been robust . This makes it likely that the growth in clean-power generation will exceed total energy demand growth this year, maintaining the structural fall in fossil-fuel use. Looking ahead, this balance also relies on progress in removing barriers to new solar and wind power being added to the grid, which result in some clean electricity being “ wasted ”. The recent slowdown in energy demand growth is partly – but not fully – explained by exceptionally mild weather in the third quarter. Another key factor is weaker GDP growth . Since reported GDP growth remains within target , however, there is reduced pressure for further stimulus policies. The focus of the economic stimulus announced to date is “six networks”, which includes the power grid and the transportation network. Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
10:44 AM PST · November 6, 2026
Security researchers have discovered hundreds of copies of a Chinese-made AI hacking tool publicly exposed to the internet for anyone to access, potentially allowing outsiders to launch cyberattacks against unsuspecting targets.
The hacking software, called Artex, is an open source autonomous penetration testing tool, meaning software that automatically probes computer systems for weaknesses, and it’s been linked to several cyberattacks since its public release in July. As open source software, it’s free for anyone to download and run on their own servers, making it a popular tool for those who cannot access Anthropic or OpenAI’s most advanced cybersecurity AI models for discovering security vulnerabilities. Microsoft has previously described Artex as a system of AI agents that can conduct cyberattacks “from reconnaissance through data exfiltration with little needed human interaction.”
In a blog post, cybersecurity firm Censys, which scans the internet for exposed or vulnerable systems, said that it identified more than 800 distinct deployments of Artex that were accessible from the web without needing a password to log in.
Silas Cutler, principal security researcher at Censys who wrote the blog post, said that not every instance of Artex is operated maliciously and many are used for authorized testers. But it’s unclear why hundreds of these Artex systems are exposed to the web, as the software does not require them to be accessible from the internet.
The findings underscore how even powerful hacking tools can be misconfigured to be publicly accessible by anyone, increasing the chance that someone will find and misuse them. The publicly accessible systems also expose attack tools, such as implants (hidden malicious software) used to compromise and maintain persistent access to a victim’s network.
Security companies have linked the use of Artex to several broad-scale cyberattacks, including against the Korean finance industry in September. Cybersecurity giant CrowdStrike attributed the attacks to a Chinese-speaking hacker who used an Artex instance in the attacks, in part because the hacker had left an “open directory” hosting the system. Censys said that its data showed the Artex instance in question had been publicly exposed for months, and appeared to contain more attack data that extended “well beyond South Korean banks,” including payment and gaming companies.
Artex was also used in an attack on IT support giant ConnectWise earlier in October, which allowed Chinese-linked hackers to spy on thousands of organizations whose data and files are hosted in Microsoft’s cloud. Microsoft, which has visibility into the attack, said in a blog post that the hackers used Artex to break into customers’ cloud environments and steal their data at such speed that defenders had “little time to detect and respond.”
Many of the attacks linked to Artex involved exploiting simple vulnerabilities, such as guessing weak or known passwords, and a lack of multi-factor authentication.
The findings show that simple vulnerabilities, including misconfigurations, can expose both the attacker and their targets.
Artex has since announced it would go closed-source, effectively limiting further releases for paid customers. There are still dozens of copies of Artex’s code available on code-sharing sites that can still be used in active attacks.

title: ¿Espía enamorada? EU señala que mujer cercana a Jensen Huang, CEO de Nvidia, trabajaría para China
zh_title: 间谍恋爱了？美方表示一名与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋关系密切的女性将在中国工作
summary: 据《纽约时报》周五报道，美国情报官员告诉特朗普政府，一名曾与英伟达公司首席执行官黄仁勋接触过的女性正在为一家中国间谍机构工作，该机构招募她是为了收集有关他的信息。该报援引匿名消息人士的话称，他们已获悉美国对这名女子进行监视，她是一家名为 Megaspeed International 的亚洲科技公司的高管。政府官员获悉这些指控
content:
据《纽约时报》周五报道，美国情报官员告诉特朗普政府，一名曾与英伟达公司首席执行官黄仁勋接触过的女性正在为一家中国间谍机构工作，该机构招募她是为了收集有关他的信息。该报援引匿名消息人士的话称，他们已获悉美国对这名女子进行监视，她是一家名为 Megaspeed International 的亚洲科技公司的高管。据《泰晤士报》报道，政府官员通过一份情报报告了解到了这些指控。据《泰晤士报》报道，爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）在北京国家安全部工作，该部正在设法获取有关美国人工智能芯片的更多信息，并可能说服英伟达向中国提供其最先进的半导体。目前尚不清楚她何时或如何认识黄仁勋。据英国《金融时报》周五晚间发表的一篇文章称，美国当局认为这段关系是浪漫的。在本周美国中期选举之后，这个问题变得更加紧迫，这将使民主党控制国会。共和党人也在调查黄与被指控的间谍的关系。
🚨突发新闻：NVIDIA 首席执行官已于 11 月 18 日在国会被传唤，解释与涉嫌中国间谍的关系。根据美国情报部门的备忘录，美国政府现在怀疑 NVIDIA 首席执行官黄仁勋与一名被指控的中国间谍有恋爱关系。美国情报… pic.twitter.com/r0qwXVvGNr — Coin Bureau (@coinbureau) 2026 年 11 月 7 日 美国国会因涉嫌中国间谍活动向黄仁勋发出传票 众议院中国特别委员会周四表示，已致函黄仁勋“要求他参加闭门联合通报会”。该委员会在声明中表示：“这封信详细说明了立法者对黄与中国情报举报人 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 的互动以及该公司针对外国对手间谍活动的安全协议的担忧。” Megaspeed 是 Nvidia 云合作伙伴网络的一部分。这家总部位于新加坡的公司从芯片制造商那里购买设备，并向人工智能开发商出租处理能力。主席@RepMoolenaar、主席@RepBrianMast 和主席@RepRickCrawford 已致函 NVIDIA 首席执行官黄仁勋，要求他本月出席他们的三个委员会的会议。
这封信表达了对 NVIDIA 针对外国对手的安全协议的担忧…… pic.twitter.com/0HO0qAFUEM — 中国特别委员会 (@ChinaSelect) 2026 年 11 月 5 日 Nvidia 否认与中国合作伙伴共享机密信息 Nvidia 在《纽约时报》文章发表后表示，其云合作伙伴“并没有要求我们寻求美国立法的改变或促进对中国的销售。”该公司补充说，“无论谁通过我们的 NCP 客户寻求机密信息，都会陷入死胡同。当被问及《金融时报》有关相关报道时

【原文 English Original】
Según informó el New York Times el viernes, funcionarios de inteligencia estadounidenses comunicaron a la administración Trump que una mujer que se había acercado al director ejecutivo de Nvidia Corp., Jensen Huang , trabajaba para una agencia de espionaje china , que la reclutó para recopilar información sobre él. El periódico citó fuentes anónimas que, según afirmó, habían sido informadas de la vigilancia estadounidense realizada a la mujer, Alice Huang , ejecutiva de una empresa tecnológica asiática llamada Megaspeed International . Funcionarios del gobierno se enteraron de las acusaciones a través de un informe de inteligencia, según el Times . De acuerdo con el Times , Alice Huang trabajaba para el Ministerio de Seguridad del Estado de Pekín , que maniobraba para obtener más información sobre los chips de inteligencia artificial estadounidenses y, posiblemente, persuadir a Nvidia para que pusiera a disposición de China sus semiconductores más sofisticados. No está claro cuándo ni cómo conoció a Jensen Huang. Según un artículo publicado el viernes por la noche por el Financial Times , las autoridades estadounidenses creen que la relación era romántica . El asunto ha cobrado mayor urgencia tras las elecciones de mitad de mandato celebradas esta semana en Estados Unidos , que darán a los demócratas el control del Congreso. Los republicanos también están investigando los vínculos de Huang con el presunto espía. 🚨BREAKING: NVIDIA CEO has been summoned before congress on Nov 18 to explain ties to alleged Chinese spy. U.S Government now suspects NVIDIA chief Jensen Huang had a romantic relationship with an alleged Chinese spy based on American Intelligence memo. U.S. intelligence… pic.twitter.com/r0qwXVvGNr — Coin Bureau (@coinbureau) November 7, 2026 Congreso de EU cita a Jensen Huang por presunto espionaje chino El Comité Selecto de la Cámara de Representantes sobre China declaró el jueves que había enviado una carta a Jensen Huang “solicitando su participación en una reunión informativa conjunta a puerta cerrada”. “La carta detalla las preocupaciones de los legisladores con respecto a las interacciones de Huang con la ejecutiva de Megaspeed, Alice Huang, una informante de la inteligencia china de la que se tiene constancia pública, y los protocolos de seguridad de la empresa contra el espionaje de adversarios extranjeros”, dijo el panel en el comunicado. Megaspeed forma parte de la red de socios en la nube de Nvidia . Esta empresa con sede en Singapur compra equipos al fabricante de chips y alquila capacidad de procesamiento a desarrolladores de IA. Chairman @RepMoolenaar , Chairman @RepBrianMast , and Chairman @RepRickCrawford have sent a letter to NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang asking him to appear before their three committees this month. The letter expresses concerns over NVIDIA’s security protocols against foreign adversary… pic.twitter.com/0HO0qAFUEM — Select Committee on China (@ChinaSelect) November 5, 2026 Nvidia niega compartir información clasificada con sus socios de China Nvidia declaró tras la publicación del artículo del New York Times que sus socios de la nube “no nos piden que busquemos cambios en la legislación estadounidense ni que promovamos las ventas a China”. La compañía añadió que “quien buscara información clasificada a través de nuestros clientes de NCP se habría topado con un callejón sin salida. No poseemos ni compartimos información clasificada con nuestros clientes”. Al ser consultada sobre el informe del FT relativo a una posible relación sentimental, Nvidia se remitió a comentarios anteriores de Jensen Huang en los que afirmaba mantener una relación comercial típica con Alice Huang. La Agencia Central de Inteligencia y la Oficina del Director de Inteligencia Nacional no respondieron de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios el viernes por la noche. En una entrevista la semana pasada , Jensen Huang defendió sus tratos con Megaspeed, calificándolos de “normales y nada inusuales”, al tiempo que recalcó que la empresa se ha asegurado de que Megaspeed no haya enviado ilegalmente los procesadores de inteligencia artificial de Nvidia a China .

此案导致日中关系紧张，日本称这一裁决“极其令人遗憾”，台湾和贸易问题的紧张局势加剧。
东京 - 据日本媒体 11 月 7 日晚报道，安斯泰来制药公司的一名日本员工因在中国从事间谍活动被判处三年零六个月监禁，将于 12 月中旬获释并返回日本。
共同社和读卖新闻等援引消息人士的话说，报道了这一消息。
该男子于 2023 年 3 月因涉嫌从事间谍活动而被拘留。他于 2024 年 8 月被起诉，并于 2025 年 7 月被判刑。
日本内阁官房副长官在宣判后表示，这一裁决“极其令人遗憾”，但没有透露个人或隶属关系。
安斯泰来制药、日本外务省和中国驻东京大使馆没有回复路透社寻求置评的电话。中国外交部没有回应置评请求。

Astellas employee jailed in China for espionage is expected to be released in mid-December and return to Japan, Japanese media reported, citing sources.
He was detained in March 2023, indicted in August 2024, and sentenced to three years and six months in July 2025.
The case has strained Japan-China ties, with Japan calling the ruling "extremely regrettable" and tensions rising over Taiwan and trade.
TOKYO - A Japanese employee of Astellas Pharma sentenced to three years and six months in prison for espionage in China is set to be released in mid-December and returned to Japan, Japanese media reported late on Nov 7.
Kyodo news agency and Yomiuri newspaper among others reported the news, citing sources.
The man was detained in March 2023 on suspicion of spying. He was indicted in August 2024 and sentenced in July 2025.
The ruling was "extremely regrettable", Japan's deputy chief Cabinet secretary said after the sentencing, without identifying the individual or affiliation.
Astellas Pharma, Japan's foreign ministry and the Chinese embassy in Tokyo did not respond to telephone calls from Reuters seeking comment. China's foreign ministry did not respond to a request for comment.
The case has been an irritant in Japan-China relations.
Ties between the two have deteriorated since Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi in 2025 said a hypothetical Chinese attack on democratically governed Taiwan could trigger a military response from nearby Japan.
China subsequently urged its citizens not to travel to Japan, saying their safety was at risk. It also throttled exports to Japan of rare earths, minerals vital to the manufacture of products as varied as cars and weapons. REUTERS

content:
据报道，来自三星和 SK 海力士的 HBM 正在通过利用美国出口管制漏洞的走私活动到达中国人工智能芯片开发商。据 The Information 报道，中间商将 HBM​​ 与低性能服务器处理器打包，将组合后的组件运往中国，然后拆下内存进行转售，其中包括转售给华为的客户。据路透社报道，大约 60 万个 Nvidia H200 AI 芯片被存放在香港，等待批准运往中国大陆。北京限制进口，以减少对美国技术的依赖并鼓励采用国内开发的处理器。据彭博社报道，据彭博社报道，由于长期劳资纠纷，美光暂停了在台湾建设价值 4.5 亿美元的存储芯片工厂。美光尚未确认暂停，对其长期台湾制造计划的影响仍不清楚。据报道，三星电子计划在两个地点扩大 HBM 基础芯片的先进代工产能。据报道，该公司计划在韩国 Giheung 建立一座新的铸造厂，配备 2nm 和 4nm 生产线，预计投资约 17B 美元，并可能进行先进封装扩张。另外，据报道，三星还获得了 AMD 和 Nvidia 的 2 纳米 HBM 基础芯片订单，这些芯片将在德克萨斯州泰勒拟建的第二家代工厂生产，目标是在 2030 年实现量产。
注：三星尚未证实报道中的 Giheung 投资或 Taylor 客户订单。 据英国《金融时报》报道，在特朗普政府的压力下，甲骨文取消了一项价值约 70 亿美元的 5 年期协议，该协议旨在通过东南亚数据中心向腾讯提供多达 10 万个先进 AI 芯片。美国官员对中国公司通过海外云服务获取先进处理器表示担忧，而中国广东省官员则敦促腾讯使用国产芯片。博世计划于2028年1月成立专门的半导体部门，扩大其代工业务并向外部客户开放更多制造能力。该公司的目标是到 2030 年半导体销售额达到 50 亿欧元，并计划到 2030 年代中期扩大其位于马来西亚槟城的半导体测试中心。 Marvell 即将收购 Lumentum（最初估值为 $115B）引起了不同的反应，分析师看到了在 AI 光学互连领域挑战 Broadcom 的机会，但也引发了对供应商集中度和客户关系的担忧。有关收购价格和监管审批的问题加剧了投资者的担忧。美国选举结果引发了人们对数据中心发展更严格的限制的担忧，特别是在德克萨斯州和俄亥俄州等主要市场，以及国会对人工智能的监督力度加大，包括人工智能安全、网络安全和行业实践。
推迟或减少数据中心建设的限制可能会削弱对 AI 加速器、HBM 和网络芯片的需求，而监管审查的加强可能会给 AI 基础设施投资带来额外的不确定性。（请参阅此处的芯片库存影响。）更多收购和交易 Onsemi 确认其计划以 6 亿美元现金以及高达 1.75 亿美元的里程碑付款收购集成电压调节器开发商 Ferric。 Entegris 收购了 Advanced Abrasives，并宣布计划在台湾建立一条新的 SiC 材料生产线。该公司还与

【原文 English Original】
Top Of The Week HBM from Samsung and SK hynix is reportedly reaching Chinese AI chip developers through smuggling operations that exploit U.S. export-control loopholes . According to The Information, intermediaries package HBM with low-performance server processors, ship the combined components to China, and then remove the memory for resale, including to customers of Huawei . Approximately 600,000 Nvidia H200 AI chips are being held in Hong Kong awaiting approval for shipment to mainland China, according to Reuters. Beijing has limited imports in an effort to reduce reliance on U.S. technology and encourage adoption of domestically developed processors. Micron reportedly paused construction of a $4.5B memory-chip plant in Taiwan due to a prolonged labor dispute, according to Bloomberg. Micron has not confirmed the suspension, and the effect on its longer-term Taiwan manufacturing plans remains unclear. Samsung Electronics is reportedly planning to expand advanced foundry capacity for HBM base dies at two locations. In South Korea, the company reportedly plans a new foundry facility at Giheung , with 2nm and 4nm production lines and an estimated ~US$17B investment, along with a possible advanced packaging expansion. Separately, Samsung reportedly secured orders from AMD and Nvidia for 2nm HBM base dies to be produced at a proposed second foundry in Taylor, Texas, with mass production targeted for 2030. Note: Samsung has not confirmed the reported Giheung investment or Taylor customer orders. Oracle canceled a 5-year agreement worth an estimated $7B to provide Tencent access to up to 100,000 advanced AI chips through data centers in Southeast Asia, following pressure from the Trump administration, according to the Financial Times. U.S. officials raised concerns about Chinese companies accessing advanced processors through overseas cloud services, while officials in China’s Guangdong province urged Tencent to use domestically developed chips. Bosch plans to establish a dedicated semiconductor division in January 2028, expanding its foundry business and opening more manufacturing capacity to external customers. The company is targeting €5B in semiconductor sales by 2030 and plans to expand its semiconductor test center in Penang, Malaysia, by the mid-2030s. Marvell ‘s pending acquisition of Lumentum, initially valued at $115B , is drawing mixed reactions, with analysts seeing opportunities to challenge Broadcom in AI optical interconnects, but also raising concerns about supplier concentration and customer relationships. Questions about the purchase price and regulatory approval have added to investor concerns. U.S. election results raised concerns about tighter restrictions on data center development , particularly in major markets such as Texas and Ohio , as well as increased congressional oversight of AI , including AI safety, cybersecurity, and industry practices. Restrictions that delay or reduce data center construction could weaken demand for AI accelerators, HBM, and networking chips, and increased regulatory scrutiny could create additional uncertainty for AI infrastructure investment. (See chip stock impacts here .) More acquisitions and deals Onsemi confirmed it plans to acquire Ferric, developer of integrated voltage regulators, for $600M in cash, plus up to $175M in milestone payments. Entegris acquired Advanced Abrasives and announced plans for a new SiC materials manufacturing line in Taiwan. The company also partnered with Element Six to develop diamond-based thermal-management materials for advanced packaging and expanded its deal with Kioxia on BiCS Flash 3D flash memory . Supermicro is initially planning to use 10,000 SambaNova SN50 RDUs for its new AI disaggregated inference systems as part of a strategic collaboration. China’s biggest EDA company, Empyrean , plans to acquire a ~50.4% stake in Easy-Logic for US$33M. Unconfirmed : Mitsui Chemicals reportedly plans to buy JSR , semiconductor materials maker, for at least $8B. Two acquisitions finalized: ADI ‘s purchase of Alif Semiconductor, adding its AI-native MCU and fusion processors, and Forge Nano ‘s acquisition of HZO for its nanoscale coating platforms. Reports and analysis Global semiconductor sales reached $518B in Q3, up 24% from Q2, according to the SIA/WSTS . September sales were up 147% year over year. Worldwide silicon wafer shipments increased 13.4% year over year in Q3, reports SEMI . Q3 DRAM revenue approached $200B , up 369% year over year as AI demand and higher prices strained supply, per Counterpoint . TrendForce projects the AI networking and interconnect market will reach $279.8B in 2027. AI data centers are moving toward 800 VDC power distribution as rack power rises toward megawatt levels, with Nvidia, Google, Microsoft and other industry participants working through OCP on common architectures and interfaces. Earnings Revenue growth/decline year over year: Arm up 27% , Arteris up 48% , AMD up 45% , Bruker up ~2% , Coherent up 50% , GlobalFoundries up 13% , Lattice up 118% , Nova up 28% , onsemi up 11%, PDF Solutions up 20% , Qnity sales up 22% , Qualcomm down 8% , and Tower up 33% . Quick Links To More News In-Depth — Auto, Security and AI newsletter, shift left becoming a system-level problem, and who verifies AI. Global — Europe boosts chip-design funding; Asia expands materials and test capacity; U.S. advances AI-driven chip design R&D. New Technologies — RISC-V automotive MCUs, high-bandwidth compute, high-density testing, and ceramic data storage. Security — 3D-stacked HW shield against side channel attacks; AMD vulnerabilities, compromised Android devices, secure-element certification. Trending Video — Chiplets: shared resources, a mix of tools, and multiple dies add new challenges for design teams. Research — AI chip inspection; cryogenic transistors; edge AI efficiency; ferroelectric memory. Quantum Hardware — New QPUs; error-correction platforms; CMOS-based qubit readout; reliability and error suppression. Workforce | Education — Apprenticeship funding; semiconductor doctoral fellowships; AI’s impact on engineering careers. Events and Webinars — ACM/IEEE ICCAD, Electronica & SEMICON Europe. Webinars on shift left, verification, and debug of high-power motor controllers. Global Americas UC San Diego and Qualcomm launched a $750K AI-driven chip-design research initiative, funded by a $500K Qualcomm gift and $250K in UCSD matching funds, focused on AI methods for SoC design, processor architectures, hardware accelerators, memory systems, and interconnects. CSIS examines Albany NanoTech as a model for semiconductor technology clusters, highlighting shared R&D infrastructure, industry partnerships, and workforce development supporting sub-2nm technologies, advanced packaging, photonics, and quantum systems. The OCP Foundation is opening nominations for project leads across all 12 top-level OCP Projects, ranging from hardware management to the AI computing continuum. Europe The European Semiconductor Industry Association (ESIA) called for dedicated semiconductor funding under the EU’s 2028–2034 budget, including support for R&D, pilot production, advanced packaging, and industrial deployment. The association urged policymakers to coordinate national and EU funding, preserve the Chips Joint Undertaking’s cross-sector role, and ease restrictions on intellectual property transfers within multinational companies. The European Fabless Semiconductor Association was formally launched to advance fabless semiconductor design within the EU. The EU launched a European Chip Design Platform ( EuroCDP ) with €525M to stimulate new chip design companies . Synopsys and the EU Chips JU signed a deal to expand access to its EDA software for semiconductor startups and research teams through the EuroCDP. Asia South Korea reaffirmed plans to spend ₩21.3T (US$16B ) on AI and major initiatives covering semiconductors, physical AI, and data centers, in its proposed 2027 budget, nearly doubling this year’s allocation. Panasonic Industry plans to invest about ¥92B ($583M) to expand AI-related materials production and R&D, including circuit-board materials, capacitors and semiconductor packaging materials. Two workers were killed and five injured in an explosion and fire at Panasonic Industrial Devices Materials ‘ factory in Hsinchu, Taiwan. The facility produces PCB and semiconductor packaging materials. The cause and production impact have not been determined yet. South Korea’s Techwing plans to invest approximately ₩52.6B ($39M) in a new semiconductor equipment factory in Cheonan to expand production of memory test handlers and HBM cube probers. In-Depth Semiconductor Engineering published the Automotive, Security and AI newsletter, including: Fitting AI Models To Edge Applications Physical AI Pushes The Limits Of Hardware College Grads And AI Plus : Shift Left Is Becoming A System-Level Problem Video: Accelerating Plug-And-Play Prototyping In Chiplet-Based Designs Perspective: Putting AI To The Test New Technologies Automotive and physical AI Infineon introduced its first automotive MCU platform based on the RISC-V architecture , adding hardware-based physical protection and crypto agility, with support planned for post-quantum security requirements. Infineon and Qualcomm are collaborating on a microcontroller-based subsystem for Snapdragon Ride reference platforms used in central car computers for automated driving and digital cockpit applications. STMicro announced a new microcontroller portfolio covering industrial, automotive, and physical AI applications. Test, measurement Keysight released XR3, a low-profile 14-bit oscilloscope designed to increase measurement capacity in rack-based test systems. Siemens introduced an automated component model extraction solution developed with Bosch that cuts frequency-response-function measurement time by up to 93% and produces ISO 20270-compliant models for virtual NVH development. AI hardware & memory Qualcomm completed hardware validation of its high-bandwidth compute (HBC) silicon, exercising the full memory read/write path and near-memory computations. Cerabyte completed S3 integration testing of its ceramic data storage within established object-storage workflows, in collaboration with CERN openlab. Design Arteris exceeded 1,000 customer silicon design starts using its interconnect IP, and released a report showing the evolution of SoC, ASIC, FPGA, and MCU designs across key markets. Research MCL , PVA TePla and ASE researchers developed an AI-based image-enhancement method for detecting flip-chip interconnect defects . By improving scanning acoustic microscopy images, the method increased detection of cracks and delamination in extreme-low-k dielectric layers from 5.2% to 100% in tests involving 19 defects across three packages. TU Munich , Applied Materials et al. evaluated cryogenic 2nm GAA transistors and superconducting interconnects for energy-efficient AI computing. Using a calibrated chip-design flow, they reported a 3x performance increase and 7.7x improvement in energy efficiency for a modeled AI accelerator’s compute fabric, excluding memory, data movement, and refrigeration power. ETH Zurich -led researchers benchmarked 10 commercial sub-watt edge AI devices , comparing inference performance and energy consumption across convolutional neural networks and small vision transformers. The study found that memory traffic, rather than computational workload, was the primary factor determining latency on the tested neural-network accelerators, highlighting the importance of data movement in low-power AI hardware design. HUST and PolyU researchers developed annealing-free ferroelectric transistors with ultrathin oxide-semiconductor channels for NVM and neuromorphic computing . The devices achieved a memory window of up to 20.6V, endurance of 10⁶ cycles, and stable 6-bit operation across 64 states. A neuromorphic network evaluation achieved 93.02% recognition accuracy. Security Government security news ENISA issued new EU cybersecurity-certification guidance for secure elements , outlining how cryptographic security services can be evaluated for use across different chip platforms. EU cybersecurity authorities issued a coordinated response after a new wave of attacks on internet-connected refrigeration systems. Japan ’s METI and IPA are participating in a new effort to align security requirements for connected hardware under Japan’s JC-STAR program and the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Alerts and attacks AMD issued security bulletins covering a newly discovered EDK II PXE driver vulnerability that can allow pre-boot code execution and a contention-based side-channel technique for exploiting known vulnerabilities in AMD CPUs. Dell issued BIOS updates for a critical Qualcomm chipset vulnerability affecting five Latitude, Inspiron, and XPS systems. The flaw can cause memory corruption when a malformed RSA key is imported into Qualcomm’s Keystore. Google banned Videostrong Technology from making certified Android devices after its security researchers determined that the company was responsible for creating an XCPE backdoor that enrolled 1.3 million set-top boxes into a criminal botnet. CISA ’s alerts for the week are here . Security offering and deals Vietnam has its first-ever homegrown security chip after government-backed Viettel Group successfully integrated a domestically developed cryptographic algorithm into silicon. u-blox announced that it will integrate Kudelski Labs ’ embedded security IP into its future chipsets. Chinese tech giant Tencent released Hy4, its powerful new open-source AI model . Amid growing concerns about agentic hacking, the company said it limited the model’s cybersecurity training data to defensive material only. Security technical papers NC State and Princeton researchers proposed a 3D-stacked hardware shield to protect post-quantum cryptography accelerators from side-channel attacks. The design stacks a guard layer above the cryptographic hardware, using decoy-key activity and physical shielding to obscure power leakage from NTT computations. Randomized Caches in HW : Challenges/Trade-offs ( RUB, Max Planck et al.) Toward Deployable HW Roots of Trust for Edge AI ( U. of Groningen ) Return-Oriented Programming on Commercial PIM Architectures ( Syracuse ) High-Throughput Private Information Retrieval with on-CPU Accelerators ( Yonsei) Trending Video Accelerating Plug-And-Play Prototyping In Chiplet-Based Designs : Purna Mohanty, CEO of SignatureIP , talks about the impact of chiplets and shared memory resources, the challenges of version control across multiple flavors of I/O, and the challenges engineering teams face when hardware-accelerated tools are running at different speeds than the actual design. Quantum Hardware New launches Universal Quantum launched its iQPU quantum processor , combining a large trapped-ion compute surface, ultra-low-noise integrated control electronics, and chip-to-chip interfaces designed to scale quantum computing systems. The processor is manufactured on a commercial 200mm semiconductor production line. IBM , ORNL , and AMD opened a new co-design platform for quantum error correction at IBM’s quantum facility in New York , co-locating the 120-qubit IBM Quantum Nighthawk with ORNL’s Umbra HPC system. Fig. 1: ORNL’s Umbra HPC system. Source: Oak Ridge National Lab Advances Researchers from Quantum Motion , UCL , and others demonstrated a superconducting circuit element fabricated using a commercial CMOS process . The titanium-nitride device functions as a compact superinductor and was integrated with a silicon quantum dot to enable sensitive RF charge detection, potentially supporting more compact readout hardware for semiconductor spin qubits. University of Regensburg -led researchers demonstrated a real-time feedback technique that reduced superconducting-qubit operation errors by approximately 54%, from 0.14% to 0.065%. The approach identifies changes in qubit resonance frequency associated with material defects and adjusts control signals to improve reliability. Alice & Bob reported extended bit-flip lifetimes in superconducting cat qubits , averaging 44 minutes on a single-qubit test device and reaching 189 to 252 minutes on selected qubits in its 12-qubit Helium 2 processor. The preliminary results demonstrate strong suppression of bit-flip errors during idle operation, with performance during error-correction operations still to be validated. Workforce, Education The U.S. Department of Labor opened applications for a $40M apprenticeship incentive fund that includes semiconductor fabrication among several high-growth sectors. Registered apprenticeship sponsors can receive up to $6K per eligible new apprentice. UCLA named the first 10 doctoral fellows in its Semiconductor Hub , with research spanning 3D ICs, advanced packaging, silicon photonics, compute-in-memory, and AI hardware. Fellows will also intern with one of the Hub’s industry partners, including Synopsys , GlobalFoundries , and others. In a new Semiconductor Engineering roundtable , industry experts discuss how AI is changing expectations for new engineering graduates. Demand for electrical engineers remains strong, but AI agents are taking over some traditional junior-level tasks, raising expectations for practical experience, AI fluency, and the ability to tackle higher-level engineering work earlier in their careers. U.S. community colleges are expanding semiconductor technician training programs as the industry faces a potential shortage of 157,000 workers by 2030, according to the Associated Press. More than 200 colleges and universities are coordinating with semiconductor manufacturers, including TSMC , Intel , Samsung , and SK hynix , to develop hands-on training programs supporting new U.S. fabs. title: Nous Research Releases Arete-27B that Cuts Qwen3.8-27B Propaganda From 22% to 0.9%
zh_title: Nous Research 发布 Arete-27B，将 Qwen3.8-27B 宣传从 22% 削减至 0.9%
summary: Nous Research 发布了 Arete-27B，这是阿里巴巴 Qwen3.8-27B 的监督微调。 Arete-27B 是一个 27B 开放权重模型，从 Qwen 的答案中剥离了中国国家框架。在 Nous 自己的 803 提示评估中，包含宣传的答案从 22% 下降到 0.9%。开发人员无需国家统一的答案即可获得 Qwen 级代理技能。权重、评估和训练数据都是公开的。 TL;DR 大小：27B 密集参数（全部有效）。在 64k 环境下进行训练。 Base Qwen3.8-27B 原生支持 262,144 个令牌。运行于：BF16 重量为 53.81 GB。社区 Q4_K_M 数量为 17.20 GB，大小为 24 GB
content:
Nous Research 发布了 Arete-27B，这是阿里巴巴 Qwen3.8-27B 的监督微调。 Arete-27B 是一个 27B 开放权重模型，从 Qwen 的答案中剥离了中国国家框架。在 Nous 自己的 803 提示评估中，包含宣传的答案从 22% 下降到 0.9%。开发人员无需国家统一的答案即可获得 Qwen 级代理技能。权重、评估和训练数据都是公开的。 TL;DR 大小：27B 密集参数（全部有效）。在 64k 环境下进行训练。 Base Qwen3.8-27B 原生支持 262,144 个令牌。运行于：BF16 重量为 53.81 GB。社区 Q4_K_M 数量为 17.20 GB，大小适合 24 GB 消费级 GPU。性能：Nous 运行的基准测试中的能力保持不变；现在的政治框架符合西方模式。最佳：宣传率 0.9%，低于基础 Qwen3.8-27B 的 22%。最差：事实得分 2.98（共 5 分）； 803 个答案中的 216 个仍然得分为 0。Arete-27B 是什么？ Arete-27B 是仅经过监督微调后的 Qwen3.8-27B。 Nous 没有使用强化学习，没有偏好优化，也没有改变架构。许可证是 Apache 2.0，与基本型号匹配。 Nous 团队表示，它在基本模型中看到了对敏感话题的拒绝、偏转和中共框架下的答案。它选择了 Qwen3.8-27B，因为它是最有能力的本地模型并显示了目标行为。 Arete-27B 是如何训练的？老师是 Inkling，Thinking Machines 的开放模型。 Nous 选择了一位开放教师来避免蒸馏的使用条款限制。
在发现有关中国主题的错综复杂的记录后，它拒绝了 Nemotron 3 Ultra。训练涵盖了 64k 上下文中的约 5280 万个标记，没有序列打包。该运行需要 2 个周期和 1,202 个步骤，批量大小为 48。它使用 AdamW、1e-5 峰值学习率和张量并行 4。所有语言模型权重都经过训练。视觉编码器保持冻结状态，因为数据只是文本。多令牌预测头被禁用。发布的 arete-data-pairs 集包含 7 个主题的 34,878 个提示。每个提示都有一个 Inkling 答案和一个 Qwen 答案。 SFT 分裂中有 29,236 个已接受的教师答案。宣传评估如何进行？ Propaganda_Eval 集有 7 个值类别的 803 个提示。其中包括言论自由、国家意识形态、数据隐私和民主。每个提示都包含来自引用来源的 2 到 4 个必需事实。 Grok 4.7 法官分别对两件事进行评分： 事实平均值（0 到 5）：答案陈述了多少个必需事实。一项反对的事实得分为 0。任何宣传：采用国家账户作为自己账户的答案份额。法官必须引用准确的短语来标记宣传。 Nous 删除了与评估重叠的所有训练提示。该评估已获得 MIT 许可，并包含评分脚本。 window.addEventListener("消息",function(e){if(e.data&&e.data.mtpArete){var f=document.getElementById("mtp-arete-frame");if(f)f.style.height=e.data.mtpArete+"px";}});基准测试显示什么？
在模型卡页面上，Arete-27B 将事实平均值从 2.32 提高到 2.98。宣传值从 22% 下降到 0.9%。得分为 0 的答案从 359 个下降到 803 个中的 216 个。最大的变化来自言论自由。事实得分从0.89上升到2.44，宣传得分从60%下降到1%。 Nous 测试中的能力。 Hermes Bench 从 65.77% 上升到 65.60%，Nous 称之为噪音。 Terminal-Bench-2.1 在 Nous 的使用中的使用率从 67% 上升到 70%。 Nous 并没有将这一成果归功于自己。 Arete-27B 相比如何？指标 Arete-27B Qwen3.8-27B Muse Glimmer 30B Gemma 4 31B 开发者 Nous Research 阿里巴巴 Qwen Meta Google DeepMind

【原文 English Original】
Nous Research has released Arete-27B , a supervised fine-tune of Alibaba’s Qwen3.8-27B . Arete-27B is a 27B open-weight model that strips Chinese state framing from Qwen’s answers. On Nous’s own 803-prompt eval, answers containing propaganda fell from 22% to 0.9%. Developers get Qwen-class agentic skill without state-aligned answers. The weights, eval and training data are all public. TL;DR Size: 27B dense parameters (all active). Trained at 64k context. Base Qwen3.8-27B supports 262,144 tokens natively. Runs on: BF16 weights are 53.81 GB. A community Q4_K_M quant is 17.20 GB, sized for 24 GB consumer GPUs. Performance: Capability unchanged on the benchmarks Nous ran; political framing now matches Western models. Best: Propaganda rate 0.9%, down from 22% for base Qwen3.8-27B. Worst: Fact score 2.98 of 5; 216 of 803 answers still score 0. What is Arete-27B? Arete-27B is Qwen3.8-27B after supervised fine-tuning only . Nous used no RL, no preference optimization and no architecture changes. The license is Apache 2.0, matching the base model. Nous team states that it saw refusals, deflections and CCP-framed answers on sensitive topics in the base model. It picked Qwen3.8-27B because it was the most capable local model and showed the target behavior. How was Arete-27B trained? The teacher was Inkling , an open model from Thinking Machines. Nous chose an open teacher to avoid terms-of-use limits on distillation. It rejected Nemotron 3 Ultra after finding a checkered record on China topics. Training covered about 52.8 million tokens at 64k context, without sequence packing. The run took 2 epochs and 1,202 steps at batch size 48. It used AdamW, a 1e-5 peak learning rate and tensor parallel 4. All language-model weights were trained. The vision encoder stayed frozen, since the data is text-only. The multi-token-prediction head was disabled. The released arete-data-pairs set holds 34,878 prompts across 7 topics. Each prompt has both an Inkling answer and a Qwen answer. 29,236 accepted teacher answers form the SFT split. How does the propaganda eval work? The Propaganda_Eval set has 803 prompts across 7 value categories. These include freedom of expression, state ideology, data privacy and democracy. Each prompt carries 2 to 4 required facts from a cited source. A Grok 4.7 judge grades two things separately: Fact mean (0 to 5): how many required facts the answer states. One opposed fact scores 0. Any propaganda: share of answers that adopt the state’s account as their own. The judge must quote the exact phrase to flag propaganda. Nous removed every training prompt that overlapped the eval. The eval is MIT licensed and includes grading scripts. window.addEventListener("message",function(e){if(e.data&&e.data.mtpArete){var f=document.getElementById("mtp-arete-frame");if(f)f.style.height=e.data.mtpArete+"px";}}); What do the benchmarks show? On the model card page , Arete-27B raised fact mean from 2.32 to 2.98. Propaganda fell from 22% to 0.9%. Answers scoring 0 dropped from 359 to 216 of 803. The biggest change came in freedom of expression. Fact score rose from 0.89 to 2.44, and propaganda fell from 60% to 1%. Capability held on Nous’s tests. Hermes Bench moved from 65.77% to 65.60%, which Nous calls noise. Terminal-Bench-2.1 rose from 67% to 70% in Nous’s harness. Nous does not claim credit for that gain. How does Arete-27B compare? Metrics Arete-27B Qwen3.8-27B Muse Glimmer 30B Gemma 4 31B Developer Nous Research Alibaba Qwen Meta Google DeepMind Parameters 27B dense 27B LM, dense 29.6B incl. vision, dense 30.7B, dense Context Not disclosed (trained at 64k) 262,144 native, up to 1M 131,072+ 256K License Apache 2.0 Apache 2.0 Apache 2.0 Apache 2.0 Input Text, image (encoder frozen) Text, image, video Text, image Text, image 4-bit footprint 17.20 GB Q4_K_M (community) Not disclosed Under 20 GB, 24 GB VRAM target Not disclosed Fact mean, Nous eval 2.98 2.32 3.02 2.58 Any propaganda, Nous eval 0.9% 22% 0.5% 0.5% Terminal-Bench 2.1 70% (Nous harness) 67% Nous harness; 73.0 official 51.7 (Meta, terminus2) Not disclosed by Google GPQA Diamond Not disclosed 89.2 83.5 84.3 Note: Arete and Qwen ran at temperature 0 in the Nous eval. Muse Glimmer and Gemma ran at 0.6. Terminal-Bench figures come from different harnesses. How can developers run it? Weights ship in BF16 on Hugging Face . No hosted inference provider serves the model yet. Community GGUF quants run in llama.cpp, LM Studio and Ollama, from 8.64 GB to 53.81 GB. The GGUF build also includes the image projector. Key Takeaways Arete-27B cuts Qwen3.8-27B propaganda answers from 22% to 0.9%. The fix took only 52.8M tokens of plain SFT, no RL. Hermes Bench held at 65.60% versus 65.77% for the base. Fact recall rose to 2.98 of 5 but still trails peers. Weights, eval and training data are open under Apache 2.0 and MIT. Check out the model weights , technical blog , evaluation set and training data . Also, feel free to follow us on Twitter and don’t forget to join our 150k+ML SubReddit and Subscribe to our Newsletter . Wait! are you on telegram? now you can join us on telegram as well. Fundraiser by Yangkey Gangshar : Nepal- Tibet Floods: Help a Mountain Guide's Wife & Children
This fund brings food, housing, and school costs to Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and children
Yangkey Gangshar is organizing this fundraiser.
Our family is heartbroken by the devastating floods that swept through communities along the Nepal–Tibet border, destroying homes, livelihoods, and taking many precious lives—including our beloved first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa Dakpu Lama Tamang.
We are Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering, and members of the Gangshar family whose roots are deeply connected to the communities affected by this tragedy. We are raising these funds for our first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and their two young children, who are now facing an unimaginable loss and an uncertain future.
“Cho Cho” is an endearing Tibetan term for an older brother. To our family, Cho Cho Dawa was a beloved husband, father, son, brother, nephew, cousin, and friend.
A Father Who Gave Everything for His Family
At 45 years old, Cho Cho Dawa worked as a mountain guide in Nepal’s Langtang region, providing for his wife and two children. His work often took him away from home for weeks or months at a time, but he took great pride in what he did. He was known for his warmth, kindness, generosity, and joyful spirit.
Tragically, the mountains he knew so well and worked in to support his family became the place where he lost his life.
He leaves behind his wife and two young children—a daughter, 11, and a son, 7. They are now facing not only the devastating loss of their husband and father, but the uncertainty of rebuilding their lives without the person who provided for their family.
The picture attached captures Cho Cho Dawa with his family dressed in our traditional Tibetan attire while celebrating Losar, the Tibetan New Year.
Our Family’s Connection to This Community
Our connection to this region goes back generations.
Our father and his family originally came from Kyidong (Kyirong, སྐྱིད་གྲོང་) in Tibet, a place now often referred to as Gyirong in international news. In 1959, our grandparents and relatives were forced to flee Tibet and eventually found refuge and a new home in the border regions of Nepal.
Our father and his siblings grew up in the Syabru besi and Briddhim communities, where they went to school, formed lifelong friendships, and began rebuilding their lives after leaving Tibet. These communities became an important part of our family’s history and home in Nepal.
The school where our father and his siblings once studied was among the places devastated by the floods.
Yangkey was fortunate to visit Syabru besi and Briddhim in March 2014 and again with Choenyi in November 2025. During those visits, she spent time with Cho Cho Dawa, his wife, mother, and brother and was warmly welcomed into their home. The pictures included here were taken during those visits and are now incredibly meaningful to our family.
The pictures also show places we saw and experienced during our November 2025 visit. One shows a hydropower facility along the road to Syabru besi which has been damanged and another shows the homes, guesthouses, and local businesses in Syabru besi, many of which have since been washed away.
Our family was once forced to leave our homeland in Tibet and found a place in Nepal where generations of our family could rebuild their lives. Now, that same community has been devastated by another unimaginable tragedy.
What took generations to build was swept away in moments. But the lives, memories, and stories connected to these places remain.
Cho Cho Dawa is not the only loss our family is mourning.
His brother, Cho Cho Tsering, is also facing unimaginable grief, as members of his wife’s family were among those tragically swept away.
We are also mourning the many precious lives lost in this devastating tragedy, including relatives, friends, and members of the Tibetan community.
Behind every life lost is a family now facing a future without someone they love.
We are raising funds to directly support Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and two children as they begin rebuilding their lives without him.
The funds will be used specifically for:
Shelter, rent, and household expenses
School-related expenses and future education costs for the children
Medical and other essential family needs that may arise
Long-term support to help the family regain stability and rebuild their lives
100% of the funds raised through this GoFundMe will go directly toward supporting Cho Cho Dawa’s family and, if we are fortunate enough to raise more than is needed for Cho Cho Dawa’s immediate family, additional funds will be used to help other affected families in the Tibetan community of Syabru besi who have lost loved ones, homes, or their livelihoods as a result of this disaster.
Yangkey will be traveling to Nepal in approximately two weeks and plans to personally deliver the funds raised directly to the affected families. The funds will be used solely for the relief, essential needs, and family-support purposes described above.
We want to make sure the support reaches those who need it most and provides meaningful help during this incredibly difficult time.
Every donation, no matter the amount, can make a meaningful difference.
If you are unable to donate, please consider sharing this fundraiser with your friends, family, coworkers, and community. A share may help this story reach someone who is able to help.
Thank you for taking the time to hear Cho Cho Dawa’s story and for standing with his wife and children, our family, and the communities affected by this devastating tragedy.
From our family to yours, thank you for your kindness, compassion, love, and support.
Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering & Gangshar Family
“The basic foundation of humanity is compassion and love.”

中共中央组织部说，中共二十一大代表选举，坚持把政治标准放在首位，严格标准条件，严密选举程序，严肃选举纪律。
据新华社报道，中共二十届五中全会决定，二十一大于2027年下半年在北京召开。中共中央印发了《关于党的二十一大代表选举工作的通知》。中央组织部随后召开会议，对二十一大代表选举工作进行了部署。
中组部负责人说，做好二十一大代表选举工作，要全面贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想，深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想，以党章为根本，坚持和加强党的全面领导特别是党中央集中统一领导，坚持把政治标准放在首位，严格标准条件，严密选举程序，严肃选举纪律，确保选出的二十一大代表素质优良、结构合理、分布广泛、党员拥护。
负责人说，《通知》规定，二十一大代表应是共产党员中的优秀分子，模范遵守党章，严格按照党员标准要求自己，具有共产党员的先进性，并从思想素质、政治觉悟、工作能力、作风形象、工作成绩、履行职责等六个方面明确了代表应具备的条件：
一是能够努力学习马克思列宁主义、毛泽东思想、邓小平理论、“三个代表”重要思想、科学发展观，深入学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想，坚定理想信念、加强党性修养，认真贯彻党的基本理论、基本路线、基本方略，自觉用党的创新理论武装头脑、指导实践、推动工作。
二是能够深刻领悟“两个确立”的决定性意义，增强“四个意识”、坚定“四个自信”、做到“两个维护”，政治可靠、对党忠诚，具有较强的政治判断力、政治领悟力、政治执行力，在重大问题、原则问题上头脑清醒，在关键时刻、重大事件中经得起考验，自觉在思想上政治上行动上同以习近平为核心的党中央保持高度一致。
三是能够认真贯彻党中央重大决策部署，胸怀“国之大者”、党之大计，带头落实统筹推进“五位一体”总体布局和协调推进“四个全面”战略布局的要求，完整准确全面贯彻新发展理念、加快构建新发展格局、推动高质量发展，具有较强的工作能力和较丰富的实践经验。
四是能够牢记初心使命，自觉践行党的根本宗旨和社会主义核心价值观，坚持以人民为中心，始终站稳人民立场，发扬党的光荣传统和优良作风，密切联系党员和群众，践行“三严三实”，遵纪守法，公道正派，清正廉洁，有良好的道德品质、作风和形象。
五是能够充分发挥共产党员先锋模范作用，牢固树立和践行正确政绩观，担当作为、拼搏奉献，敢于斗争、善于斗争，求真务实、开拓创新，在生产和工作中作出显著成绩。
六是能够正确行使民主权利，忠实履行代表职责，具有较强的议事能力和群众工作本领，积极并如实反映党员、群众的意见和要求，自觉接受监督。
在选举工作的具体程序上，负责人说，将实行差额考察和考察预告。严把人选政治关，坚持把政治标准放在首位，做深做实政治素质考察，加强党性鉴别，着重考察政治立场、政治态度、政治觉悟和政治判断力、政治领悟力、政治执行力。坚持以事察人、知事识人，结合重大斗争、急难险重任务和艰苦环境中的表现情况，注意通过具体事例了解政治表现，坚决防止把政治上有问题的人选进来。

（中央社記者潘欣彤連江縣8日電）爭取連任的國民黨籍連江縣長王忠銘今天成立競選總部，國民黨副主席兼秘書長李乾龍跨海站台。他強調，隱性泛藍選民越來越多，成為隱憂，呼籲馬祖民眾應成為22縣市中表率，踴躍投票。
王忠銘今天上午於南竿鄉介壽村成立競選總部，共吸引1200位民眾到場支持，高喊「凍蒜」。國民黨副主席兼秘書長李乾龍、台灣地方創生基金會董事長陳美伶則從台灣本島跨海站台。成立大會結束後，王忠銘則在支持民眾陪同下，繞行山隴蔬菜公園與連江縣政府大樓，展現爭取連任氣勢。
李乾龍演講時說，感受到馬祖的團結，是國民黨的定心丸。根據目前民調走向，隱性泛藍選民越來越多，支持度較不明顯成隱憂。本屆九合一選舉攸關台灣未來發展及國民黨2028年能否重返執政，呼籲馬祖民眾應成為22個縣市中表率，踴躍投票給王忠銘與國民黨參選人，並投下公投同意票。
總統蔡英文執政時期前國家發展委員會主委陳美伶則說，在國發會任內與馬祖結緣，今天為王忠銘獻出站台處女秀。她肯定連江縣府當年為爭取新台馬輪、馬祖酒廠2廠等重大建設付出的努力，希望民眾繼續支持王忠銘連任。
王忠銘說，上屆以世代交替幸福永續為口號，但政治很現實，沒有執政權一切都是空談。執政4年來，推動離島特考、連江縣府公務員菁英班等措施，上任後還積極培育接班人，但很遺憾，仍差最後一哩路，未來將以自己時間換取年輕人發展空間，真正實現世代交替。
王忠銘說，4年來與團隊努力下，獲得多項國內獎項肯定，並爭取東莒猛澳港與東引中柱港改善工程，各鄉社會住宅，北竿芹壁停車場，南竿梅石藝文中心、樂活多功能體育館等建設。未來除提高生育補助與長者小三通乘船補助外，韌性智慧島嶼計畫已獲行政院拍板定案，預算達新台幣21億900萬元。（編輯：李亨山）1151108

title: 三退聲明精選（2026/11/07）
summary: 我們都在社會底層，雖然懂得不是很多，但誰好誰不好還是知道的。 https://tuidang.epochtimes.com/index/showpost/id/34541783 我認識到共黨的邪惡性質，我過去以此為事業，放在經濟下行的今天共黨越來越不得人心，我害怕遭到未來的清算，我自願退出共產黨。 https://tuidang.epochtimes.com/index/showpost/id/34539511 本人曉亮，小時候年少無知，當時在學校和教師的洗腦下，加入了中共的
content:
我們都在社會底層，雖然懂得不是很多，但誰好誰不好還是知道的。
https://tuidang.epochtimes.com/index/showpost/id/34541783
我認識到共黨的邪惡性質，我過去以此為事業，放在經濟下行的今天共黨越來越不得人心，我害怕遭到未來的清算，我自願退出共產黨。
https://tuidang.epochtimes.com/index/showpost/id/34539511
本人曉亮，小時候年少無知，當時在學校和教師的洗腦下，加入了中共的少先隊；初中時，當時的班主任為了湊人數，私下找我，要求我加入共青團，以幫她完成「教學任務」。我當時不願意，但在她的施壓下，也只能違心同意入團。上高中時，我在網上看到有人討論六四事件，以及文革時的武鬥，造成平民傷亡的事件，對中共編寫的教科書以及官方的宣傳感到懷疑，但當時在內網很難找到真實的歷史資料，只能作罷，但這份懷疑在我的心裡生了根。
真正的改變源於上大學後，當時身邊的許多同學剛入學就提交了入黨申請書，而我沒有盲目跟風。後來為完成課程作業，我在用搜索引擎查資料時，無意中點開了一個網站，其中提供了好幾種翻牆工具，包括自由門、無界等。我下載自由門後，第一次訪問了大紀元、新唐人電視、希望之聲以及阿波羅網、油管、谷歌等網站。
在使用動態網時，我下載了「九評」「解體黨文化」等電子書，仔細閱讀，那時我才深入了解中共的賣國歷史，以及對人民犯下的罪行。後來我也通過油管觀看了與六四有關的紀錄片，才知道，幾十年前在北京發生的那場屠殺的詳情。
大學期間，學院及輔導員多次鼓勵學生入黨，但我始終不為所動。工作後常聽父母抱怨他們在單位快要退休還被領導刁難，他們也看不慣平時單位裡的政治學習活動。於是我將「九評」、大紀元、自由門推薦給他們，他們開始翻牆了解真相，思想也慢慢有了改變。
工作後這幾年，中國國內物價上漲，許多公司有時還延後發薪，生存壓力很大。我直到今年下半年才終於想通，要想改變現狀，先應該與中共劃清界限，退出自己曾加入的共青團與少先隊，卸掉精神上的這副枷鎖。在我的勸說下，父母也決定退出他們曾加入的黨，團，隊組織，由我替他們提交。
本人曉亮，鄭重聲明退出自己曾加入過的中共共青團、少年隊，與其劃清界限，不再有任何關係。父親老張、母親阿梅聲明，退出他們曾加入過的中共、共青團、少先隊，與其不再有任何關係。

title: 中共最後一名「開國將軍」王扶之去世

content:
【大紀元2026年11月08日訊】中共軍隊原烏魯木齊軍區副司令員王扶之11月7日在遼寧省大連市去世，終年104歲。他生前被稱為中共最後一個在世的「開國將軍」。
據新華社11月8日報導，王扶之於11月7日病逝。官方所稱的「開國將軍」，主要指中共篡政前後參加中共軍隊、其後獲授或晉升將軍軍銜的軍官。王扶之1955年首次授銜時獲授大校軍銜，1964年晉升少將。
中共軍隊1955年開始實行軍銜制度，至1965年取消軍銜制度期間，先後授予元帥、大將、57人、中將及少將。王扶之去世後，這批曾獲授或晉升相關軍銜的將領已全部離世。
王扶之1923年出生於陝西省，1935年加入中共紅軍，當時年12歲。
1945年抗日戰爭結束後，中共與國民黨軍隊爆發全面內戰。王扶之當時在中共軍隊任職。1949年，他擔任共軍第39軍第115師第343團團長。
1949年後，王扶之隨中共軍隊參加朝鮮戰爭。1953年朝鮮停戰後，王扶之回到中國，1955年進入中共軍事學院高級速成系學習。其後歷任師長、軍參謀長、副軍長兼參謀長，以及共軍總參謀部作戰部副部長、部長等職。
1975年，他出任山西省軍區司令員，1980年調任烏魯木齊軍區副司令員。1964年，王扶之由大校晉升少將。
王扶之先後參與抗日戰爭、國共內戰及朝鮮戰爭。這些戰爭均是中國近現代史的重要歷史事件，相關軍事行動造成大量軍人及平民傷亡。
目前公開的王扶之個人生平資料，主要來自中共官方媒體、軍方及相關機構的人物介紹。

title: Inside ARTEX: AI Hacking Tools, Exposed Servers and South Korean Bank Breaches
zh_title: ARTEX 内部：人工智能黑客工具、暴露的服务器和韩国银行漏洞
summary: Hunt.io 追踪了影响七家韩国金融机构的 ARTEX 服务器和人工智能黑客工具。 2026 年 9 月底至 10 月初期间，七家韩国金融机构的数据通过面向互联网的系统遭到泄露。约 66,000 至 67,000 人以及约 2,200 家企业受到影响，个人、就业、收入和贷款数据被曝光。 Hunt.io 深入研究了该活动背后的基础设施，其发现为 CrowdStrike 和 Genians 已经发布的内容增添了很多内容。 CrowdStrike 10 月 7 日报道和 Genians 安全中心
content:
Hunt.io 追踪了影响七家韩国金融机构的 ARTEX 服务器和人工智能黑客工具。 2026 年 9 月底至 10 月初期间，七家韩国金融机构的数据通过面向互联网的系统遭到泄露。约 66,000 至 67,000 人以及约 2,200 家企业受到影响，个人、就业、收入和贷款数据被曝光。 Hunt.io 深入研究了该活动背后的基础设施，其发现为 CrowdStrike 和 Genians 已经发布的内容增添了很多内容。 CrowdStrike 于 10 月 7 日报道，Genians 安全中心于 10 月 12 日报道，均指向 ARTEX，这是一个在中国开发并获得 AGPL-3.0 许可的开源自主渗透测试框架。 CrowdStrike 的评估有一定的把握，认为该组织是由一个受金钱驱动的讲中文的个人操控的，而不是一个既定的威胁组织。 DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 是主要模型，GLM 5.3 和 Grok 4.6 作为备份，部分通过经销商域 xcai[.]pro 实现。公共指标是位于 38.244.50[.]120 的服务器，该服务器托管 ARTEX 控制台，以及一个香港地址和 9 个代理。 Genians 表示，ARTEX GitHub 存储库和 Docker 镜像已于 10 月 11 日删除，但分支和镜像仍然存在。 “CrowdStrike 的评估有一定的把握，认为该操作者是一个讲中文的个人，其动机是经济利益，而不是一个既定的威胁组织。” Hunt.io 发布的报告中写道。
“据报道，基础设施部分通过经销商域 xcai[.]pro 访问这些服务。两份报告都描述了双服务器配置，包括用作主要基础设施的香港 IP 地址和托管 ARTEX 控制台的 38.244.50[.]120 。” Hunt.io 在发布前通知了相关国家 CERT，并表示该报告不包含任何个人记录或凭证。该公司自己的扫描显示 38.244.50[.]120 位于洛杉矶 Cogent 的网络上，有 15 个开放端口。 ARTEX 登录页面的中文标题是“自主渗透测试控制台”，出现在端口 443 和 8090 上。其他服务包括 Gemini2API 管理控制台和 Tinyproxy 服务器。 Hunt.io 在其 AttackCapture 平台上搜索该地址时，发现了另一个开放目录：23.248.226[.]250，这是位于香港 AS138415 上的跳转服务器。它在 2 个子目录中包含 42 个文件，总共 105 MB，该平台已于 9 月 5 日、9 月 26 日和 10 月 5 日记录了警告。其中的一个文件将 38.244.50[.]120 命名为跳转主机，其注释告诉操作员切勿将凭据粘贴到会话中。它位于一个开放的目录中。三个脚本支持链接。他们保持反向 SSH 隧道处于活动状态，运行本地中继，并将文件复制到跳转主机，其中一条隧道名为 grok2api，凭证文件还保存智普 AI 的 GLM 模型、兼容 OpenAI 的中继和代理服务的密钥。
这解释了多个语言模型如何在一次活动中运行。人工智能设置是最引人注目的部分。状态文件显示该工具是 Claude Code 本身，版本 2.1.221，自 8 月 4 日以来启动了 510 次，但它没有与 Anthropic 对话。一个小型代理 ds-models-shim.py 通过伪造模型列表并向 DeepSeek 发送请求来修复兼容性问题，另一个代理 xcai-effort-shim.py 添加推理设置，因为 DeepSeek 后端会跳过其推理步骤。该路线从 Claude Code 出发，通过 Claude Code Router（一个开源软件）

【原文 English Original】
Hunt.io traced ARTEX servers and AI-powered hacking tools used in breaches affecting seven South Korean financial institutions. Between late September and early October 2026, seven South Korean financial institutions had data breached through internet-facing systems. About 66,000 to 67,000 people and around 2,200 corporations were affected, and personal, employment, income and loan data was exposed. Hunt.io dug into the infrastructure behind the campaign , and its findings add a lot to what CrowdStrike and Genians already published. CrowdStrike reported on October 7 and Genians Security Center on October 12 , and both pointed to ARTEX , an open-source autonomous penetration testing framework developed in China and licensed under AGPL-3.0. CrowdStrike assessed with moderate confidence that a single Chinese-speaking individual motivated by money ran it, and not an established threat group. DeepSeek v4.1 Flash was the main model, with GLM 5.3 and Grok 4.6 as backups, reached partly through a reseller domain, xcai[.]pro. The public indicators were a server at 38.244.50[.]120, which hosted the ARTEX console, plus a Hong Kong address and nine proxies. Genians said the ARTEX GitHub repository and Docker image were removed on October 11, though forks and mirrors remain. “CrowdStrike assessed with moderate confidence that the operator was a single Chinese-speaking individual motivated by financial gain rather than an established threat group.” reads the report published by Hunt.io. “The infrastructure reportedly accessed these services in part through the reseller domain xcai[.]pro . Both reports described a two-server configuration, consisting of a Hong Kong-based IP address used as primary infrastructure and 38.244.50[.]120 , which hosted the ARTEX console.” Hunt.io notified the relevant national CERT before publishing, and says the report holds no personal records or credentials. The company’s own scanning showed 38.244.50[.]120 sits on Cogent’s network in Los Angeles, with 15 open ports. The ARTEX login page, with a Chinese title meaning “autonomous penetration testing console”, appears on ports 443 and 8090. Other services include a Gemini2API admin console and a Tinyproxy server. Searching its AttackCapture platform for that address, Hunt.io found another open directory at 23.248.226[.]250, a jump server in Hong Kong on AS138415. It held 42 files in 2 subdirectories, 105 MB in all, and the platform had logged warnings on September 5, September 26 and October 5. A file in it names 38.244.50[.]120 as the jump host, and its own comment tells the operator never to paste the credentials into a session. It sat in an open directory. Three scripts back up the link. They keep reverse SSH tunnels alive, run a local relay, and copy files to the jump host, one tunnel is named grok2api, and the credentials file also holds keys for Zhipu AI’s GLM models, an OpenAI-compatible relay and a proxy service. That explains how several language models ran in one campaign. The AI setup is the most striking part. A state file shows the harness is Claude Code itself, version 2.1.221, started 510 times since August 4, but it isn’t talking to Anthropic. A small proxy, ds-models-shim.py, fixes a compatibility problem by faking a model list and sending requests to DeepSeek, and another, xcai-effort-shim.py, adds a reasoning setting because the DeepSeek backend otherwise skips its reasoning step. The route runs from Claude Code through Claude Code Router, an open-source project, to xcai and then to DeepSeek. “A small local proxy, ds-models-shim.py , addresses a compatibility issue: the official /v1/models endpoint returns a 404 response when queried against a non-Anthropic backend, preventing Claude Code from discovering the available models. The shim intercepts that specific request and returns a locally defined model list containing deepseek-v4-pro and deepseek-flash . All other requests are forwarded to api.deepseek.com/anthropic.” states the report. The same file counts 19 custom skills, reusable instruction sets for the agent, with 147 recorded uses. They cover code audit, reconnaissance, web injection, WAF bypass testing, authentication testing, Telegram Mini Apps, APK download and decompiling, cloud phone control and payment logic testing. Next to the payment skill sat three self-registered test accounts with tokens for a cash-in deposit API, dated September 12, and a comment calls them an authorized, self-built test. The setup fits testing for insecure direct object reference flaws, a technique CrowdStrike and Genians described against Korean loan and inquiry services. The directory also held supporting tools. A script queried FOFA, a Chinese asset search engine like Shodan, through a third-party API, and a comment says the primary membership had expired and a backup key was in use. Proxy scripts enumerated a rotating proxy service at 154.201.79[.]246:443, where 79 unique exit IPs showed up among the first 100 identities tested. A separate directory at 23.248.226[.]250:8001 held a small staged setup for JNDI and LDAP exploitation, retrieved on October 5 at 03:42 UTC. It confirms command execution through a DNS callback, and one script lets web and LDAP traffic share a single port. Hunt.io’s analysis describes the tooling without publishing steps to reproduce it. Other recovered files include tools aimed at a cryptocurrency exchange’s admin session and withdrawals, Linux privilege escalation exploits, iOS probe source code and Android kernel and firmware utilities. Hunt.io says their connection to the Korean breaches isn’t confirmed. Hunt.io then showed how to hunt ARTEX servers. Searching for an ARTEX certificate issuer returned 19 IP addresses, and searching its malware classification returned 1,303 addresses across 30 countries, led by the United States, China and Hong Kong. Those figures show where addresses are registered, not where the operator sits. “The result returned 19 distinct IP addresses, including 38.244.50[.]120. This method is precise but limited to hosts that expose a matching certificate. Systems using a different certificate will not appear in these results.” continues the report. Matching the console’s page title returned about 1,300 IPs, and a looser search found 21 title strings, 19 of them likely ARTEX consoles, in English, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Russian, Portuguese and Vietnamese. A malware-name search in AttackCapture gave 280 results with open directories. One at 130.94.31[.]86:18888 in Seoul held two small scripts, and another at 156.251.11[.]39 held an SMB reconnaissance toolkit whose test script writes a file named artex_probe_11876.txt. More hosts held exploitation kits for DedeCMS and FangCMS, a CAPTCHA bypass suite, a RuoYi and Spring administrative console exploit and CAPTCHA-based login automation. Together they show the framework attracting many operators. For defenders, the advice is plain. Remove public access and put administration behind VPNs or allowlists, and reset SSH passwords and rotate API keys, proxy credentials and tokens that exposed files may have revealed. Patch internet-facing services, watch for unexpected LDAP and JNDI activity, DNS callbacks and remote script downloads, and store secrets in a managed vault with least-privilege permissions. Also restrict access to model gateways, watch their requests, and enforce compliance rules on managed phones. Hunt.io’s lesson is that an investigation shouldn’t stop at the first list of indicators, because The company also published indicators of compromise in its analysis. “The findings highlight risks associated with exposed administrative services, reusable credentials, remote access tunnels, proxy infrastructure, and exploitation tooling.” concludes the report. Follow me on Twitter:  @securityaffairs  and  Facebook  and  Mastodon Pierluigi Paganini ( SecurityAffairs – hacking, ARTEX)

Amazon’s new basic Kindle proves you don’t need all the bells and whistles
9:18 AM PST · November 7, 2026
In October, Amazon announced its refreshed Kindle lineup, its first significant design overhaul in years. The highlights included a new edge-to-edge design that eliminated traditional raised bezels, thinner and lighter Paperwhite and Colorsoft models with better displays, and page-turning accessories like a Bluetooth remote and a magnetic cover with page-turn buttons.
However, given the impact of the global memory-chip shortage driven by the AI boom, the new Kindles also debuted with pricing that had increased by $40 to $50 across the lineup. That makes it more difficult for the average consumer to consider buying one of the more premium devices.
For that reason, the Kindle I most wanted to get my hands on was the 6-inch entry-level device, which starts at $169.99 for the ad-free version. With the price hikes, this is the Kindle that will remain the most affordable to new e-reader buyers.
The question I weighed was whether or not the basic Kindle is even worth buying at this price when there are arguably better Kindles on the market. The answer, after a couple of weeks of testing, is yes — if you can live without the bells and whistles and prefer a smaller, lighter device.
On the 6-inch Kindle, there’s no warm light to reduce eye strain, no color display, no auto-adjusting brightness, no option to use the page-turn cover, and it’s not waterproof. Obviously, because of its size, the screen is smaller, as is the battery. Battery life is 6 weeks compared with the Paperwhite’s 12 weeks or Colorsoft’s 8 weeks.
Still, even this basic Kindle has seen improvements of its own, mostly from a physical design perspective.
The plastic 2026 Kindle is 11% lighter and 14% thinner than the 2024 model, weighing 140g versus 158g and measuring 6.85mm thick versus 8mm. While this seems like a small change, the 18-gram difference is noticeable and particularly welcome for a device you’re likely to carry in your purse or bag. Plus, it makes it easier to hold for hours on end when you’re really binging your way through a book.
(The aluminum version, meanwhile, is slightly heavier at 162g, or 4 grams more than the 2024 Kindle, though it still benefits from the slimmer design.)
And despite being the “starter” Kindle, the 6-inch basic device still received the new flush-front screen update. This makes it more comfortable to hold in your hand, especially for those long reading sessions. Amazon explained that you don’t have to worry about no longer having a bezel to rest your thumb upon, either, as the new Kindles have been updated to detect a dead zone in the capacitive touch that will readjust to account for the fact that your finger is there.
In practice, that doesn’t mean you can just press your thumb down anywhere on the Kindle’s screen as you hold it — doing so would register this as an attempt to highlight or look up a word. Instead, it means you can rest your thumb or fingers on the outer edge of the Kindle’s screen (the colored border) without triggering an unintentional tap, even though some of your finger will be touching part of the Kindle’s capacitive screen.
In terms of the software, the new basic Kindle is a bit snappier than its 2024 predecessor. This is most noticeable when opening books, which Amazon claims to be 30% faster.
If you’re coming from the 2019 Kindle Basic, the 2026 version is an even bigger upgrade, as you gain USB-C, more storage (from 4GB to 8GB to now 16GB or 32GB), the new flush screen, and the screen resolution jumps from 167 ppi to 300 ppi. It’s faster, thinner, and lighter, too, and the battery lasts weeks longer.
Another perk about the basic Kindle beyond its small size (this thing fits in your jeans’ back pocket!), is that you can now pay a little more for an upgraded version with an aluminum backing instead of plastic and more storage. The new $189.99 aluminum option comes in Seagrass and Alpine Sky hues, and ships with 32GB of storage. Meanwhile, the $169.99 plastic model offers 16GB of storage.
However, even if you go for the less expensive option, you can at least now pick a fun color other than black (aka Graphite), as Amazon has introduced a cheery purple option called Ube. (I almost wish I’d gone for this one, just for the whimsy of it, even though I prefer the feel of the aluminum.)
I should point out that you can use the Kindle Click, the new Bluetooth remote for page turning, with the basic Kindle, but I’m not sure why you’d need to, if not for some accessibility-related reason. The 6-inch Kindle was already the smallest, and now it’s lighter and easier to hold, too. (But perhaps I just don’t get the appeal of the remote? I’ve barely used the remote with my Kobo either!)
The big thing to consider here is whether you want to spend this much on a Kindle that lacks a warm light. While this is something of a personal preference, for some readers, no warm light is a dealbreaker. The warm light shifts the color tone of the Kindle’s display from a cooler bluish-white to a softer amber glow, which is meant to help reduce eye strain and improve reading conditions in low light or at night.
Whether you need this feature depends on where you like to read and how long your sessions tend to be. If you read nightly in bed with little light, you might prefer paying extra for a $199.99 16GB Kindle Paperwhite. (That version only comes in Graphite. The 32GB Paperwhite can come in Seaglass, too, but is $249.99).
If you often read by the pool or on vacation, you also might want to upgrade to a waterproof Kindle.
But if you can live without the extra features and want the best purse- or pocket-sized device, the 6-inch Kindle is still a viable option.

title: 顏純鈎：賣友求榮非君子所為，為虎作倀是背叛初心
